description: Restricted unit-cost adjacent-transposition edit distance over Eq slices.
state: Immutable finite slices; local rows or hash/shift state; returned witness, distance or offsets.
cost: O(n*m) equality/arithmetic operations; three rows of O(min(n,m)) words.
forward: D(i,j)=min(D(i-1,j)+1,D(i,j-1)+1,D(i-1,j-1)+[a[i-1]!=b[j-1]],D(i-2,j-2)+1 when crossed adjacent elements agree); boundaries D(i,0)=i,D(0,j)=j.
inverse: behavior_complement and reverse_reconstruction are distinct first two typed models; see model.md.
checks: Compiled mutation must fail an assertion; see model.md#tests.
limitations: Finite native evidence is not universal verification.
Syntax projection excludes expansion and semantic resolution.
